critique_history.assessment:
- The valves look like thick, blunt clam shells rather than elongated mussel valves; narrow them and sharpen the hinged end.
- The broad painted stripes overwhelm the surface; use finer continuous growth bands with actual raised ridges.
- The hinge area appears bulky and abrupt; make it compact and smoothly connected to both tapered tips.
The complete hinged, partially open teardrop valves have convincing brown-and-cream growth rings and clearly visible dark interiors.
